policy: Historical receipts are preserved, not rewritten. Only matched PASS receipts from controlled native-gated runs are eligible for paired performance comparisons. An invalid offline replay is never interpreted as faster rendering.

diagnostics.reason: Interrupted smoke contains only a baseline receipt; no matched challenger receipt. Native window ownership and focus-emulation state were not independently gated.
Playwright connectOverCDP timed out during browser initialization before trial replay.

One diagnostic A/D pair passed the original smoke gates, but no independent native-window/keyguard/awake checks or explicit focus-emulation disable were recorded. Not used for a winner or confidence interval.
Playwright browser initialization timed out before offline trials. Eight lab contract tests passed independently of this setup failure.

Both arms confirmed native Chrome foreground, unlocked/awake display, native page focus with focus emulation disabled, and thermal status 0 before/after. Both nevertheless attempted requests under explicit page-network offline conditions; cache coverage was incomplete.

The original generic smoke gates passed, but both arms retained two observed contacts after a reduced touchMove set. The alleged one-finger pan changed target zoom from approximately 4 to 2.5, so this is not accepted two-to-one transition evidence. The replacement transport uses explicit partial touchEnd for released ID 2 and checks observed contact identities.

recovery.observed: Protocol commands were acknowledged during the attachment timeout, but pre-existing blank targets had not completed page initialization. Native Chrome navigation to a lab URL and cleanup of verified abandoned lab blank targets restored a successful 1.10-second attachment probe.
recovery.privacy: No personal browsing tabs were read or closed. A diagnostic screen capture containing a system overlay was deleted and is not published. Native benchmark proof excludes system status and browser toolbar regions.
